name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3
short_description: A RUNRIO-organised road race at SM Mall of Asia, Pasay, Philippines, on 6 September 2026, with a 32 km headline race plus 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3 was run on Sunday 6 September 2026 at SM Mall of Asia, Seaside Boulevard, Pasay, Philippines, organised by RUNRIO for Trilogy Run Asia. Its headline race was the 32 km, the third and longest leg of the Manila series, with 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km races alongside it.

core_facts.organizer: Runrio (brand: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia)

pros: The biggest Leg 3 of the 2026 series: 2,735 finishers in the 32K
A six-hour limit for the 32K leaves room for slower runners
Finishing the 32K completes qualification for the National Finals 42K
Medal, towel and lootbag for every finisher; shirt for the 21K and 32K
cons: No route map, water-station list or per-distance start times published
Run in rain and 100% humidity in 2026, with a thunderstorm at 7.15am
Crowded 32K start: one in ten finishers took over 11 minutes to cross the line
Entries cannot be refunded, deferred or transferred
research_highlights: The race is held at SM Mall of Asia / Seaside Boulevard in Pasay City, and Runna classifies the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia course as flat.
Manila Leg 3 2026 offers 5K, 10K, 21K and 32K distances, part of a progressive three-leg format per city that builds up in distance across the year before a National Finals in November.
The series draws large fields in Manila — over 11,600 runners took part in the March 2025 Manila Leg 1, with about 5,000 in the 16K category alone.
The event is organized by Runrio (RUNRIO president Rio de la Cruz) with Santé Barley as title sponsor, and has run multi-year editions (formerly branded HOKA Trilogy Run Asia).
A Pinoy Fitness forum commenter noted that fun-run distances like the 5K typically start very early, around 5am, with about a 1-hour cutoff for that category.
research_watchouts: No independent participant race reports or reviews with course/organization feedback were found for this specific Manila Leg 3 event or its recent predecessors — most available coverage is organizer press releases and results-only news pool stories.
Listings on review aggregator sites (e.g. Let's Do This) show this event currently has no submitted runner reviews.

faqs.question: What distances were offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Manila Leg 3 offered four distances: 32 km, 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km. The 32 km was the headline race and the biggest field, with 2,735 of the 5,484 finishers in 2026. It is the Leg 3 race runners need, after the 16 km and 21 km, to qualify for the National Finals marathon.

faqs.question: Where is the race venue located?
faqs.answer: The race started and finished at SM Mall of Asia on Seaside Boulevard, Pasay City, Metro Manila. The organiser listed the event from 3am on Sunday 6 September 2026. Parts of the route were closed to traffic on race day, according to the race FAQs, which pointed runners to the official road advisory.

faqs.question: Who organised this race?
faqs.answer: RUNRIO organised the race for Trilogy Run Asia Inc., with Santé Barley as title sponsor. Manila Leg 3 was part of a 2026 series of 16 races across five host cities, in which each city hosts three legs of rising distance before the National Finals at SM Mall of Asia on 8 November.
